title: Used-Accessory Amount of a Returned PAP Therapy Equipment Unit
content:
# Used-Accessory Amount of a Returned PAP Therapy Equipment Unit

**Valuation rule.** The used accessories that came with a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit returned to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request are a mask and the tubing set, valued at Summit Ridge self-pay prices: a nasal mask at **89.00 USD** and standard tubing at **15.00 USD**. The used-accessory amount the patient bears is the mask value plus the tubing value, rounded half up to the cent.

| Item | Value (USD) |
|---|---|
| mask (nasal mask) | 89.00 |
| tubing (standard tubing) | 15.00 |
| used-accessory amount | 104.00 |

**Worked example (hypothetical unit).** A CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) bought outright comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request. The mask value 89.00 plus the tubing value 15.00 is 104.00, already a whole cent, so the used-accessory amount is 104.00.

**Points of judgement.**
- *At which prices are accessories valued?* At Summit Ridge self-pay prices.
- *When is the amount rounded?* Once, half up to the cent, on the amount as a whole.
